title: What does it ask for
tagline: Pick the real asks, let filler pass
verb: Pick the skills a role's postings ask for from sixteen on a board.

title: Higher or lower
tagline: Which skill do more postings want
verb: Say whether more or fewer postings ask for the next skill.
outcome: Learn which skills {role} postings ask for most.

title: Build the hire
tagline: Draft a hire, then let postings judge
verb: Draft a candidate from three cards at a time on a budget.

title: Guess the role
tagline: Name the job from its skills
verb: Name a real posting's role from its skills, giveaway last.
outcome: Learn the skill that gives each role away.

title: Spot the real ask
tagline: Mark what a posting really asks for
verb: Mark the real asks in a posting and let the filler pass.
outcome: Learn to read a posting past the filler.

title: Climb the ladder
verb: Sort four sentences about one skill onto Entry to Lead.

title: Where's the demand
tagline: Guess where the open jobs are
verb: Pick which of two roles has more open postings right now.
outcome: Learn where the open jobs are this week.

title: Skill path
tagline: Hop from your field to a new role
verb: Hop along linked skills from your field to a role you want.
outcome: Learn which skills link your field to {role}.
